{{Youmayd|an organization that wanted to overthrow the senate|Combine|[[Combine (disambiguation)]]}}
In the years before the Empire, '''The Combine''' was a militant [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] that wished to take over the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. The lacked [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]-spanning power of the later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but had very similar troops, ships, agents and officers.

==Behind the scenes==
The Combine was created as an antagonistic organization, and used as an example of how to adapt a [[Wizards of the Coast]] adventure to any era or situation by changing the story details, and leaving the underlying mechanics and statistics in place.
